-
To share your feedback, please post in the [General Discussion](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/overwatch/c/general-discussion) forum.

-
For a list of known issues, visit our [Bug Report](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/overwatch/c/bug-report) forum.

-
For troubleshooting assistance, visit our [Technical Support](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/overwatch/c/technical-support) forum.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Achievements listed on the Career Profile page can now be earned in Quick Play Classic

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed several AI pathing issues in the Archives missions
- Reduced volume of Slicer's pre-attack sound in Uprising as they were previously a bit too prominent
